couplets.en: May the moon of your beauty rise somewhere.

lines: Aaj arzaan ho koi harf shanaasaai ka
couplets.en: May a word of recognition come freely today.

Come once more, healer of hearts wounded by love.

lines: Koi vaada, koi iqraar maseehaai ka
couplets.en: Give us some promise, some pledge that we may heal.

lines: Saaz-o-saamaan baham pahuncha hai rusvaai ka
couplets.en: Everything is in place for our disgrace.
